structural_change: HC quarter engine (plan (b) d4g, HBM-B-RTL2b): 3x3 ring of 8 bank tiles around the hub (hc_<q> + centre, coordinator 10-17 23:45: no empty middle). Chain clockwise from W: b0 W, b1 NW, b2 N, b3 NE, b4 E, b5 SE, b6 S, b7 SW; masters by pin plan (R0 / R180 only): e2 = b2 / b6, e0 = b4, b0 = b0, ca = b1 / b5, cb = b3 / b7. HUB = the ring hole: hc_<q> (ot_hbm_hc_q_static, was its own 432^2 tile hc_<q>) + the quarter-engine centre (control-only x_wave rx, ingest sequencer, descriptor relay, 6-level partial-sum subtree TLA 7, 9-region reset). The 2,048-b x_wave link is now internal (hc_q output register -> the 8 bank beat slices 256 b each); faces: W bank 0 (+ chain exit s_i 2,049 b), N lg_rr + banks 1-3, E lg_wq/lg_rq + bank 4, S F20 / result / gathered / root links + banks 5-7. NOTE for H-D4G: the hc_q LG link (4,448 b) must leave the ring through the inter-tile channels. HCRING 10-19: params DRLY 2 (coordinator 0fi U-ring die relay, = the d4g contract) and CHX 11 (HH-9 bank chain pin registers, +11 chain edges per pass: subtree valid VD = SB + DRLY + CHX); re-gate after the bank kits close.
